WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    o.account_id as order_account_id,
    d.A3 as region_name,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_count) as overall_average
  FROM grouped
),
with_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    g.order_account_id,
    g.region_name,
    g.group_count,
    g.group_count - oa.overall_average as diff_from_overall
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
regional_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    region_name,
    AVG(diff_from_overall) as regional_average
  FROM with_diffs
  GROUP BY region_name
),
paired AS (
  SELECT 
    d.order_account_id,
    d.region_name,
    d.group_count,
    d.diff_from_overall,
    d.diff_from_overall - r.regional_average as final_diff
  FROM with_diffs d
  JOIN regional_avgs r ON d.region_name = r.region_name
  WHERE d.diff_from_overall > r.regional_average
)
SELECT 
  order_account_id,
  region_name,
  group_count,
  diff_from_overall,
  final_diff
FROM paired
ORDER BY final_diff IS NULL, final_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
